--- is_distinct_from_subquery.sql
(SELECT 1) IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT 2)

--- AST
&ast.IsDistinctFromExpr{
  Left: &ast.ScalarSubQuery{
    Rparen: 9,
    Query:  &ast.Select{
      Select:  1,
      Results: []ast.SelectItem{
        &ast.ExprSelectItem{
          Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
            ValuePos: 8,
            ValueEnd: 9,
            Base:     10,
            Value:    "1",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Right: &ast.ScalarSubQuery{
    Lparen: 28,
    Rparen: 37,
    Query:  &ast.Select{
      Select:  29,
      Results: []ast.SelectItem{
        &ast.ExprSelectItem{
          Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
            ValuePos: 36,
            ValueEnd: 37,
            Base:     10,
            Value:    "2",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
(SELECT 1) IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT 2)
